selector:
/* Arbana visual adapter. Layout, content, data attributes and event handlers are retained. */
:root

/* White app surface, light blue-gray secondary surfaces and thin separators. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-stay,.k3-services,.k3-route,.kp-hotel,.kp-place,.kp-detail-card,.kf-card,.ktd-event-card,.ktd-file-card,.kti-card,.kdf-card,.kfb-card,.ksd-card,.ksd-flow-card,.ksd-service-card,.ksd-other-card,.ksd-room-page-card,.ksd-hotel-entry-card,.ksd-included-services-card)

/* Digital key: Arbana's flat blue surface and white action. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .k3-access

/* Shared control shapes match H / n3 / RI in the Arbana kit. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-service-cta,.kp-primary,.kf-primary,.kti-primary,.kdf-primary,.kfb-primary,.ksd-primary,.ksd-flow-primary,.ksd-door-primary,.ktd-add-primary,.kp-detail-cta)

/* Floating navigation: equal items, outline icons, selected light-blue pill. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-nav,.kp-nav,.kf-nav,.ktd-nav,.ksd-nav)

/* Dialogs, feedback layers and toasts keep their existing opening/closing logic. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-sheet,.kp-sheet,.kf-sheet,.ktd-sheet,.ksd-sheet)

/* Home key card: room identity, availability and a single clear action. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .k3-access

/* Compact key variant, following the original Tatyana card composition. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .k3-access

/* One masthead specification, used by every top-level section in both documents. */
:is(#keysUnifiedPrototype,.keys-module-screen) .keys-app-header

/* Root page headings follow the same rhythm as Find and Chats. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .k3-scroll>.keys-app-header,#keysUnifiedPrototype .kf-scroll>.keys-app-header

/* Nested screens use the same surface, typography and round controls as Arbana. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kp-head,.ktd-head,.ksd-head,.kti-head,.kdf-head,.kfb-head,.ksd-detail-head)

/* One bottom-navigation geometry, shared by every screen that retains navigation. */
:is(#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype,.keys-module-screen) .keys-bottom-nav

/* Both home cards begin with icon / title / value on the same baseline. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-home,.ka-home) .kh-account-row,#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-daily .kh-meal-row

/* Secondary actions: common type, icon and baseline in every host section. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-detail-link,.ka-referral-footer,.kse-card-action,.kpa-services-all,.kb-action-link,.kn-card-actions a,.kn-card-actions button)

/* A footer is a 44 px row, without an extra inset beneath it. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.ka-referral-footer,.kse-card-action,.kpa-services-all,.kh-nearby-actions button,.kn-card-actions a,.kn-card-actions button)

/* Filled and outlined standalone actions use the same 48 / 14 / 14 geometry. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-primary,.kn-primary,.kpa-manage,.kse-find,.kh-open-door,.kfb-primary,.ksd-sheet-action,.ksd-close,.kp-primary,.kf-primary,.kti-primary,.kdf-primary,.ksd-primary,.ksd-flow-primary,.ksd-door-primary,.ktd-add-primary,.kp-detail-cta,.kp-secondary,.kf-secondary,.kti-secondary,.kdf-secondary,.ksd-flow-secondary,.ksd-other-secondary)

/* Compact reward CTA stays compact, aligned with the neighbouring text action. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .ka-reward-search

/* Secondary page headers share the profile/booking title size. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-detail-header h2,.keys-profile-header h1,.ksd-head h1,.ksd-detail-title h1,.kfb-title h1,.kfb-success h1,.ksd-sheet h3,.ksd-sheet h4)

/* Shared white cards and information rows. Branded hero layouts remain distinct. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-home,.kpa-home,.ka-home,.kse-home,.kb-details,.keys-benefits)

/* Original Arbana controls receive semantic hooks in the integration build. */
#root [data-keys-button]:is([data-keys-button="primary"],[data-keys-button="secondary"],[data-keys-button="danger"])

/* Find uses the same segmented-control geometry and type as Nearby. */
:root

/* Find landing: shared text roles, Regular and Medium. Root titles use display below. */
#root main:has(> [aria-label="Способ поиска"])

#root main:has(> [aria-label="Способ поиска"]) :is(.keys-find-history-city strong,.keys-find-saved-title strong,.keys-find-recent-track button>strong),
#root main:has(> [aria-label="Способ поиска"])>button strong

/* Keep text inputs at 16 px to prevent mobile browsers zooming on focus. */
#root main:has(> [aria-label="Способ поиска"]) input

/* Host copy that used to fall through to the base prototype's 13 px paragraph. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kse-inspiration-copy>p,.keys-passport-intro,.keys-passport-card>p:not(.keys-passport-formats),.kf-sheet>p,.ksd-sheet>p,.k3-sheet>p,.kp-sheet>p,.ktd-sheet>p)

#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-detail-header h2,.keys-profile-header h1,.ksd-head h1,.ksd-detail-title h1,.kfb-title h1,.kfb-success h1,.kf-sheet h3,.ksd-sheet h3,.k3-sheet h3,.kp-sheet h3,.ktd-sheet h3)

/* The same title role is used for a card regardless of its parent screen. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-hotel-summary h1,.kh-nearby-heading h2,.kh-pass-today>strong,.kpa-hotel-heading h1,.kpa-arrival-countdown,.kpa-total>strong,.ka-trip-copy h1,.ka-referral-copy>strong,.kse-benefits-heading>strong,.ksvc-orders-heading h2,.ksvc-orders-bill strong)

/* Plain outline icons are the current Keys standard. Icon slots are not cards
   or badges: no fill, outline, shadow or rounded tile behind the glyph.
   Controls, status badges, avatars, map markers and illustrations have their
   own surfaces; this rule does not remove their meaning or tap targets. */
:root

/* Use the same 24 px icon column in home, catalogue, order history and bill. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kpa-service,.ksvc-bill-row)

/* Embedded Find / Chats: named icons and the original module's decorative
   row/empty-state icon slots, never interactive controls or status indicators. */
#root :is(.keys-notice-icon,.keys-checkin-success-icon,.keys-find-saved-icon,.keys-hotel-location-icon),
#root :is(span,div).grid.place-items-center:is(.shrink-0,.mb-4,.mb-5):has(>svg:only-child):not(.absolute):not([role]):not([class*="size-5"]):not([class*="size-[18px]"]):not([class*="size-[19px]"]):not([class*="size-[22px]"]):not(label *):not([role="radio"] *):not([role="checkbox"] *)

/* One label role for every content tab, including dynamically opened filters.
   Active state changes colour and indicator, never font size or weight. */
#root [data-keys-tabs]>button,
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kn-switch>button,.ksd-menu-tab,.ksd-food-tab,.kti-tab)

/* One compact card contains independent orders and their execution times. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysStayDetails .ksvc-active-orders

/* Collapsed summary and disclosure use the existing secondary links and Nearby switch. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysStayDetails .ksvc-orders-heading>div

/* Shared late-checkout block used by booking details and the checkout dashboard. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kb-late-block

/* Problem reporting follows the same page, field and card roles as feedback. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kb-problem-page

/* Hotel catalog: standard type roles, white surfaces and compact photographic cards. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysStayDetails .ksvc-page

/* Shared service-detail components, including basket and request states. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysStayDetails .ksvc-secondary

/* Current account follows the white cards and typography of Trips. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysStayDetails .ksvc-bill-summary

/* Feedback uses the same type scale, surfaces and semantic green as the UI kit. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysFeedbackFlow

/* A compact confirmation followed by one self-contained, optional tip card. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysFeedbackFlow [data-kfb="success"] .kfb-success

/* Quiet form sections, without nested cards. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype #keysFeedbackFlow .kfb-card

/* White canvas with airy blue surfaces from the Arbana palette. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .k3-phone

/* Compact room information followed by an explicit stay timeline. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-pass-room

/* Arbana typography: token scale, regular body / medium emphasis.
   Scope the mobile scale and rebind its size tokens here so the legacy theme's
   root scale cannot disable it. Important declarations only isolate typography
   from the old prototype's global small/p and heading rules. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kh-home,.kh-overlay)

/* Shared home surfaces: a single panel language, with visible interaction feedback. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-quick-actions button+button:before

/* The hotel summary and digital key form one compact stay card. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-stay-heading .kh-booking-link

/* White utility cards keep the home surface clean and preserve its geometry. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-daily :is(.kh-meal-row,.kh-account-row)

/* Arbana type tokens for the room and stay hierarchy. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-pass-room-line>strong

/* Breakfast removal follows the shared secondary button treatment. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-primary.kh-breakfast-remove

/* Nearby uses the existing Arbana font, palette and mobile text scale. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kn-nearby

/* The same white surface, type hierarchy and secondary link as home cards. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kn-interests

/* Two comparable facts replace a stack of repeated metadata. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kn-card-facts

/* HTML markers are buttons in MapGL; keep the existing marker colours over shared button resets. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kn-map button:is(.kn-place-pin,.kn-hotel-pin)

/* Final alignment with the approved Ключи UI kit. */
#keysFindPages .kp-thumb

/* Approved bottom navigation from the base home design. */
#keysFindPages .kp-nav

/* Compact metadata and statuses remain visually secondary, but readable. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-chip,.kp-tag,.kp-distance,.kf-deal-tag,.ktd-chip,.ktd-time,.ktd-live,.ktd-day,.ktd-ticket-kind,.ktd-ticket-code,.kti-help,.kti-found small,.kdf-hint,.kfb-label,.kfb-points,.ksd-chip,.ksd-flow-value,.ksd-now-state,.ksd-history-state,.ksd-place-type)

/* Text links and small actions get a stable 12 px label and larger hit area. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-link,.kp-link,.kf-link,.ksd-link,.ksd-history-link)

/* Lists need more vertical room after increasing supporting text. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-row,.kp-form-row,.kf-row,.kti-method,.kti-row,.ksd-row,.ksd-flow-row)

/* Primary navigation labels are slightly larger without changing its geometry. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-tab,.kp-tab,.kf-tab,.ktd-tab,.ksd-tab)

/* Forms and sheets must not fall back to tiny helper text. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kf-sheet,.kp-sheet,.ktd-sheet,.ksd-sheet,.kti-field,.ksd-detail-content) :is(label,p,small)

/* One vertical rhythm across top-level and nested screens. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-section,.kp-section,.kf-section,.ktd-section,.kti-section,.ksd-section)

/* Comfortable rows: larger copy no longer touches separators or icons. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-row,.kp-form-row,.kf-row,.kti-method,.kti-row,.ksd-row,.ksd-flow-row)

/* Cards and independent content blocks keep a consistent breathing space. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-card,.kp-search-form,.kf-card,.ktd-today,.kti-card,.ksd-card,.ksd-flow-card)

/* Chips and statuses stay compact but gain enough internal height. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-chip,.kp-pill,.kp-tag,.kf-pill,.kf-deal-tag,.ktd-chip,.ktd-live,.ktd-stay-status,.ksd-chip,.ksd-now-state,.ksd-history-state)

/* Form copy and bottom sheets need separation after type enlargement. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.kf-sheet,.kp-sheet,.ktd-sheet,.ksd-sheet)

/* Navigation remains visually light; the larger label receives more space. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype :is(.k3-tab,.kp-tab,.kf-tab,.ktd-tab,.ksd-tab)

/* One grouped reward message, followed by a clear next-booking action. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .ka-home .ka-trip-pass

/* Earned reward: a compact balance badge beside the benefit. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .ka-reward

/* Photo identifies the hotel; the shared blue pass groups booking facts. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-reservation

/* Booking-owned share action and pre-arrival detail page. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-hero-share

/* Confirmation document: stable label/value columns and consistent sections. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-booking-details

/* Travel documents: compact rows matching the shared service-card typography. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-documents

/* A soft heading and inset blue pass mirror the card used during the stay. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-welcome-ribbon

/* Emphasize the remaining days without adding another row. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-arrival-countdown

/* Three days before arrival: primary registration and one compact action group. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-checkin

/* Equal secondary actions directly below the booking pass. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-booking-buttons

/* Arrival instructions use the shared card, type and spacing system. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-overlay:has(.kpa-instruction) .kh-detail-header

/* Shared typography roles for both pre-arrival home states. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-home

/* Route app chooser uses the shared overlay as a bottom sheet. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-overlay:has(.kpa-route-chooser):not([hidden])

/* Local visual simulation: no location request or taxi order is sent. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-overlay:has(.kpa-go-preview)

/* Visible application handoff, followed by a separate Go visual language. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kh-overlay:has(.kpa-go-launch)

/* Keep provider attribution above the taxi preview panel. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-go-map-live

/* Shared service typography must also override the legacy catalogue small/button rules. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kpa-service

/* Arbana's compact pill and grouped popover, outside the application screen. */
#keysScenarioControls

/* Check-in steps and completion use the shared typography and surfaces. */
.keys-checkin-steps

/* Photo discovery keeps Arbana's dark stage, separate from the light app shell. */
.keys-module-screen:is([data-screen-type="swipe"],[data-screen-type="shared-swipe"])

/* Search history uses compact text cards; Recent contains hotel photos only. */
.keys-find-history,.keys-find-recent

/* Saved hotels are a visible destination beside the search tools. */
.keys-find-history

/* Search results keep filters, map and hotels on one page. */
.keys-results-sticky

/* Invisible text-free hit areas keep the map accessible and swipeable. */
.keys-results-map-handle

/* Wide photo gallery with a compact, two-column hotel summary. */
.keys-result-hotel

/* Hotel detail: photography, essential facts, then reasons to choose and practical details. */
.keys-hotel-gallery

/* Hotel price explanation uses the shared bottom sheet and compact data rows. */
button.keys-hotel-pricing-amount

/* Room selection follows the application's 20 / 17 / 14 / 12 type roles. */
[data-screen-type="hotel"] main:has(.keys-room-selection) h1

/* Payment: same type scale, card surfaces and control geometry as the app. */
[data-screen-type="reservation-payment"] main

/* Shared summaries: the same outline icons, content rhythm and footer links. */
#root [data-screen-type="reservation-payment"] .keys-payment-summary

/* Property classification is separate from the guest review score. */
.keys-hotel-identity>h1

/* Compact guest list; forms use the same bottom-sheet pattern as other flows. */
#root [data-screen-type="reservation-payment"] .keys-guest-panel

/* Hotel sharing uses standard sheet typography and equal secondary actions. */
dialog:has(.keys-hotel-share-content) h2

/* A single, distinct search surface; supporting discovery remains on white. */
#root main .keys-search-hero

/* Hotel selection shares the app's secondary header, tiles, fields and sheet scale. */
#root .keys-selection-page

/* Saved hotels reuse the result card and become a first-level destination. */
.keys-favorites-heading

/* Saved hotels enter from the Find title, keeping four primary navigation tabs. */
.keys-find-heading

/* Three compact illustrated entries, aligned with the existing discovery cards. */
.keys-find-collections

/* Identity → membership → grouped settings: one clear reading order. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kf-phone[data-screen="profile"] .kf-profile

/* Personal documents stay separate from trip receipts and vouchers. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .keys-passport-page

/* Loyalty: a travel wallet, membership and short expandable guides. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype#keysUnifiedPrototype .kf-phone[data-screen="benefits"]>.kf-scroll

/* Trip accruals use the same compact rows as the rest of Benefits. */
#keysUnifiedPrototype .keys-benefits-history
